en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historic mill complex with steep gabled roofs and many small attic windows. A central archway entrance is marked with the word "Rothalmühle" on the facade. Trees without leaves and a wooden fence stand in front, and a watercourse with a smaller building is visible to the left, suggesting a watermill installation. Red printed captions in German identify the location as Rothalmühle in Graz, on Körösistrasse. There is also a printer's credit along the left margin.
